text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! ☆ A private beach BBQ is total 
hype vibes, no cap! I brought fireworks 
too, so let's close out with a bang and 
get super pumped up, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Kama at the end... Ah, imitation crab 
stick?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I brought fireworks! I'm telling everyone 
let's have some fun tonight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that's how it is... ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned that Palmer would bring a 
fresh breeze to the Mejiro family, so I 
was looking forward to it, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She truly is a "breath of fresh air." 
Welcome to the Mejiro estate, Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll go get us some drinks. What kind do 
you like~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thx! Then I'll have the same thing as 
Palmer-chin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Palmer-chin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, hearing it again, I just thought it's 
rather a lovely nickname.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the barbecue at the Mejiro 
family's private beach kicked off with 
great cheer—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So goooood!! This is legit delicious! You 
sure eat well, don'tcha~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you liked it. Please eat 
plenty before you head home.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wha—!? Thanks a bunch, Ardan-senpai~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the pleasure is ours. Please 
continue to take good care of our dear 
Pamachin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, Palm.../!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just got a little envious. I 
thought... I'd like to call you that too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin~. The carrots are done 
grilling, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no way! What is this... so 
embarrassing!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! McQueen might get a real shock if 
she sees this, Palmer-chin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the nickname "Palm-chin" became 
quite the craze in the Mejiro household 
for a while.
